Description: Read this first: this uses the same free endpoint Microsoft Edge uses for its own read-aloud feature. It is not a supported Microsoft API and could change or stop working without notice. If you need a guarantee, configure the Azure Speech provider, which is the same voices with a contract and a bill. If the endpoint fails at runtime the browser client falls back to the speech synthesis built into every modern browser, so a page always has a voice. With that said: add "listen to this article" to any page with a single element. Audio is generated and cached on your own server, word highlighting follows real timings from the engine rather than estimates, and nothing about a listener is ever stored. No table, no migration, no IP, no user agent. Free and MIT licensed, with no build step and no third-party dashboard.
